entries.conclusion: Frozen model identity is DINOv3 ViT-B/16, cls_patch_attention, 512 input, checkpoint epoch_018.pt.
The audited corpus has 30000 images, 15000 authentic and 15000 fake, five brands, and no product-disjoint guarantee.
Temperature 0.24038200410185356 was fitted on 2998 calibration samples.
The locked five-brand final test has 3006 samples and calibrated ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, and F1 of 1.0, with zero false-authentic and zero false-fake counts.
Resize/recompression of one Richard Mille reference remains an uncovered false-fake stress case. Eight of nine known stress false-fake events were caught.
The shadow quality gate is LOW_RESOLUTION or LOW_CONTRAST to REVIEW, then P(fake) at 0.50. It is not promoted.
Phase 35 is OOD_FAIL. 408 OOD samples, 337 authentic escapes, unseen-luxury escape 0.8814432989690721.
Phase 36 is an underpowered independent watch-like observation and does not confirm or overturn Phase 35.
Phase 37 admitted no additional protocol-compliant corpus.
Phase 38 recommended scope reduction and forbade promotion.
The live customer path is still the DINOv2 stack. This phase did not edit those backend files.
Production readiness was conditional and not a promotion.
